Name: Smart Junimos - Auto-Planting and harvest
Author: Huykyo99
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#00e5ff][b]Smart Junimos[/b][/color][/size]
[size=4][i]Double the efficiency, automate planting, and paint your farm with a rainbow of helpers![/i][/size][/center]

[size=4][color=#ff4081][b]Tired of lazy Junimos who refuse to work in the rain, leave your empty fields unseeded, and only let three friends out of the hut at a time?[/b][/color][/size]

It's time to upgrade your farm helpers. [b]Smart Junimos[/b] completely overhauls your Junimo Huts, transforming them from simple collectors into highly organized, hyper-efficient agricultural machines. They work longer hours, coordinate their tasks, and automatically replant seeds directly from their hut's chest—even in the middle of a thunderstorm!

[line]

[size=5][color=#ffeb3b][b]✨ KEY FEATURES[/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*][b]🌾 Smart Auto-Planting:[/b] Put your seasonal seeds in the Junimo Hut chest, and watch them plant them on empty tilled dirt automatically! No more rushing to plant seeds yourself.[/*]
[*][b]🌧️ Rain or Shine (Storm Support):[/b] Rain or lightning won't scare them off anymore. Your Junimos will work diligently through any weather, ensuring your crops are harvested and planted on time.[/*]
[*][b]🌈 6 Rainbow Helpers:[/b] Up to [color=#ff1744][b]6[/b][/color] Junimos can work simultaneously (doubled from the vanilla limit of 3!). Each Junimo spawns with a unique, vibrant color ([color=#ff1744]Red[/color], [color=#ff9100]Orange[/color], [color=#ffea00]Yellow[/color], [color=#00e676]Green[/color], [color=#2979ff]Blue[/color], [color=#d500f9]Purple[/color]) creating a stunning rainbow on your farm![/*]
[*][b]⏰ Extended Work Hours:[/b] Junimos now start their shifts earlier at [b]7:00 AM[/b] (instead of 8:00 AM) and keep working until [b]7:00 PM[/b].[/*]
[*][b]🧠 High-IQ Coordination:[/b] Junimos will never target the same tile twice, and they disperse in different directions when leaving the hut to maximize efficiency and coverage.[/*]
[*][b]⚙️ Automate Mod Compatibility:[/b] Built-in compatibility with the [i]Automate[/i] mod! Automate is patched to ignore seeds inside the Junimo Hut chests, protecting them so your Junimos can plant them.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][color=#00e5ff][b]🚀 HOW TO USE[/b][/color][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Build a [b]Junimo Hut[/b] on your farm.[/*]
[*]Open the hut's inventory chest and place any [b]seasonal seeds[/b] inside.[/*]
[*]Relax and watch your 6 colorful helpers keep your fields clean, harvested, and fully planted![/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][color=#b388ff][b]🛠️ REQUIREMENTS & INSTALLATION[/b][/color][/size]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley v1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI v4.0.0+[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation:[/b]
[list]
[*]Download and extract [b]Smart Junimos[/b].[/*]
[*]Copy the [font=Courier New]SmartJunimos[/font] folder into your Stardew Valley [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] directory.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI![/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Simply put, six Junimos automatically plant and harvest crops, regardless of the weather. That’s all there is to it.

Manifest.Name: Smart Junimos
Manifest.Description: Junimos work from 7 AM, automatically plant seasonal seeds from the hut chest, and support 6 different colored Junimos.
